title: Metamaterials
description: Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.

puzzle.goal: A lattice of thin wires behaves like a dilute electron plasma for microwaves, and an array of split rings acts as tiny resonant LC circuits that respond to the magnetic field. Write the relative permittivity of the lossless wire plasma and the relative permeability of the ring array (a resonance at ω0 with filling factor F), and combine them into the refractive index, choosing the root that keeps energy flowing away from the source when both are negative.
puzzle.name: Double-negative index of a Drude–Lorentz wire / split-ring medium
puzzle.ask: Find the refractive index n (a negative number) at the frequency below.

vars.F: filling factor of the split rings

puzzle.method: A free-electron plasma gives ε = 1 − ωp²/ω²; a driven resonator gives μ = 1 − Fω²/(ω² − ω0²). n² = εμ; when ε and μ are both negative the phase velocity is opposite to the energy flow, so take the negative root.
